title: Sell declared electrical articles only if approved
what: Sell or hire prescribed classes of electrical appliance only if approved by the Director and labelled as prescribed.

sources.title: Electricity Act 1945 (WA)
sources.quote: The Director may by notice published in the Gazette prescribe any class or type of electrical appliance which shall not after a date specified in the notice be sold, hired or exposed for sale or hire or advertised for sale or hire, unless the electrical appliance of that class or type is approved by the Director and is stamped or labelled if and as prescribed in the regulations
